name: code-review-harness
description: Read-only, whole-codebase architecture + code + security evaluation of an existing repository. Deterministic evidence (SLOC, complexity, churn x complexity hotspots, ownership, semgrep/gitleaks/osv-scanner packs), specialist agents per module x dimension, per-component threat model + category sweep, adversarial verification (three-lens 2-of-3 panel computed in code), stable fingerprinted findings, honest coverage accounting, ISO 25010 architecture scorecard, and deterministic ANALYSIS_REPORT.md / ARCHITECTURE.md / ROADMAP.md / REPORT.html / SARIF. One fresh process per stage, resumable, budget-capped. Never modifies the code under review.
